tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Filling of potholes using Jet Patcher at R R Nagara Zone-1 Bengaluru west city corporation

itemList.description: Repairs to potholes upto 50 mm by using semidense bituminous concrete in cold mix by using emulsion including marking the potholes/patches in regular shape and size, Removing loose packets., Dewatering in potholes, tack, coats of 25 kg/10 Sqm with RS1 emulsion before & after laying of mix etc. by use of advanced jetpatching technolgy machine of approved make and specification having capacity 5.50 to 8.00 cubic meters with auxillary engine with direct drive to heavy duty blower, Rorary Positive auxillary engine with direct drive to heavy duty blower, Rotary Positive Displacement Blower With direct drive and Separate airline silencer. (Capacity 15 PSI, Flow rate 1370 cum/hr). Compacting using plate compactor, cleaning as directed by Engineer-in-charge of the Work etc. Complete (bitumen @ 5% by Weight of mix). (capacity -15 PSI, Flow rate 1370 Cum/hr). Compacting using plate compactor. cleaning as directed by Engineer-in-charge of the work etc. complete (bitumen emulsion RSI @ 10% by weight of mix)
